ad2020339564f4d5e441a68f757f5293a3160fbd.changelog: Faithful 32x – June 2026 Release Faithful 32x is back and better than ever! Featuring support for Chaos Cubed and Tiny Takeover, we've gone all out in rethinking and refining even the longest-standing textures. Blocks, items, entities, GUI, all of it! From the new sulfur caves to sticks, tools, and even wooden planks, it's still the Faithful you know and love, but finely tuned for 2026. Wrangling baby mobs, exploring noxious caves, playing oddly bouncy minigames, building new constructions, and playing the game we all love should be better than ever! Thank you for your patience and support, and we hope you enjoy. From now on, downloads for older versions will not be uploaded here and can be accessed from the (recently redesigned) [downloads page on our website](https://faithfulpack.net/downloads). For the full changelog please visit [our website](https://faithfulpack.net/faithful32x/June2026). ![](https://database.faithfulpack.net/images/website/posts/32x/June2026.jpg)
